items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: and I'd be the leader, you know. So I think Zutty got Scoops and Dave Young and Chuck and Teddy...

ctx.x: It's funny how I hit on that name. I haven't mentioned that name in ages! But they offered me the job at the same salary I was getting with Fletcher, and I'd be the leader, you know. So I think Zutty got Scoops and Dave Young and Chuck and Teddy...

items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: so when Sam opened again he had Roy Eldridge to come in you see with his band.

ctx.x: I can remember that. He made a record of that. It was on Decca, I remember now. Yes. Well then, what were the circumstances of Roy coming in?

Well, Roy used to come in and sit in with us see. Because he was with Fletcher Henderson at the Grande Terrace at the time. So, Fletcher and the Grande Terrace had some kind of trouble and Roy quit you know. And then Roy after Sam, opened up the Three Dances again because the river had broke in and had flooded the dance floor. Yes, because it was in the basement you know, so when Sam opened again he had Roy Eldridge to come in you see with his band.
But I was still the feature you know.
